  • Deal execution: Support bid clarifications and contract negotiations to ensure a smooth and successful close.
  • Pilots & co-development: Work with GEA Digital Units and Core Technology Centers to identify pilot customers, lead co-development projects, and scale proven solutions.
  • Customer engagement: Plan and deliver site visits, presentations, and demos; present solutions to customers and status updates to internal stakeholders.
  • Product expertise & enablement: Act as the regional NPE Digital Products Sales Specialist; champion digitalization via the GEA Academy; participate in Core Technology Centers (Competence Centre) training and serve as a regional trainer for local Service Sales organizations.
  • Strategic relationship leadership: Serve as a trusted advisor and foster long-term relationships with a strong customer-centric, growth-mindset approach.

Este profissional terá perfil hands‑on, atuando diretamente na resolução de incidentes, execução de projetos e melhorias contínuas, mantendo forte proximidade com o negócio.

  • Atuar de forma hands‑on em incidentes, troubleshooting e análise de causa raiz (RCA).
  • Liderar um time multidisciplinar de desenvolvedores com conhecimentos em Progress, SQL Server, Python e integrações.
  • Gerenciar e priorizar demandas de suporte, melhorias evolutivas e projetos.
  • Atuar no atendimento e gestão de chamados críticos via ServiceNow.
  • Planejar e executar projetos de evolução tecnológica e integrações.
  • Coordenar integrações utilizando APIs REST e SOAP.
  • Garantir governança técnica dos ambientes e qualidade das entregas.
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada e atuar como ponto focal entre TI e negócio.
  • Ter disponibilidade para atuações emergenciais quando necessário.
Requisitos Técnicos
  • Experiência sólida com ERP Datasul (TOTVS).
  • Conhecimento prático em Progress/OpenEdge.
  • Experiência com SQL Server.
  • Vivência com integrações via APIs REST e SOAP.
  • Conhecimento em Python para automações e integrações.
  • Experiência com WMS, MRP e sistemas legados.
  • Vivência com ServiceNow ou ferramenta ITSM similar.
Diferenciais

Fundada em 1950, a Ypê é uma empresa 100% brasileira, líder no segmento de higiene e limpeza que há mais de 70 anos preza pelo bem-estar, qualidade de vida e saúde das pessoas.

title: Operador A&V Senior CLT
description:
Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um Operador A&V Sênior para atuar como referência técnica e líder de produção em eventos de grande porte e alta complexidade.

Esse profissional será responsável por definir a arquitetura técnica das produções, estruturar fluxos de áudio e vídeo, garantir redundância de sistemas e assegurar a excelência técnica em todas as etapas do evento — do planejamento à execução.

Também atuará como principal ponto de apoio técnico para as equipes operacionais durante eventos presenciais, híbridos e transmissões ao vivo.

Responsabilidades

Liderança Técnica (Chief Operator)

  • Atuar como liderança técnica de palco ou cabine de operação, coordenando e supervisionando operadores Júnior e Pleno durante montagem, operação e desmontagem dos eventos.

Arquitetura de Produção

  • Projetar e dimensionar a arquitetura técnica de eventos ao vivo complexos, incluindo:
    eventos híbridos
    múltiplos palcos
    produções com broadcast e redundância
  • Definir fluxos de sinal, topologia de infraestrutura AV e a melhor solução tecnológica para cada produção.

Resolução de Incidentes Críticos (Nível 3)

  • Atuar como ponto final de escalonamento técnico para falhas críticas ou sistêmicas, solucionando problemas complexos em tempo real durante a operação.

Inovação e Evolução Tecnológica

  • Pesquisar, testar e implementar novas tecnologias e fluxos de trabalho, incluindo soluções de:
    media servers
    tracking systems
    AV-over-IP

Gestão Técnica de Fornecedores

  • Apoiar a seleção e gestão técnica de fornecedores de equipamentos e serviços especializados, garantindo alinhamento com os requisitos técnicos da produção.
Requisitos

Experiência

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência comprovada em produção audiovisual, eventos ao vivo de grande porte ou operações de broadcast.

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Domínio de arquitetura e fluxo de sinal de áudio e vídeo.
  • Experiência com protocolos de rede audiovisual como:
    Dante
    NDI
  • Operação avançada de mesas de áudio digitais e switchers de vídeo de nível broadcast.

Streaming e Produção

  • Experiência avançada na operação e customização de softwares de produção e streaming, como:
    vMix
    OBS Studio ou similares.

Autonomia

  • Autonomia total para tomada de decisões técnicas estratégicas e coordenação da operação audiovisual durante eventos.

Formação

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas como:
    Produção Audiovisual
    Rádio e TV
    Comunicação Social
    ou áreas correlatas.

Certificações (Diferenciais)

Certificações técnicas ou treinamentos avançados em tecnologias e fabricantes do setor, como:

  • Q-SYS
  • Blackmagic Design
  • Certificações em redes AV (ex.: Dante)
  • Certificações em sistemas de videoconferência e broadcast

Idiomas

Inglês – Intermediário a Avançado (desejável)

Necessário para:

  • leitura e interpretação de riders técnicos
  • suporte de equipamentos internacionais
  • interação com clientes ou participantes estrangeiros

Espanhol - é considerado um diferencial.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

title: LATAM Engineering Director - Power Conversion
description:
Job Description Summary

The Director of Engineering leads a comprehensive organization of Design, Product, Test and Process engineers responsible for the end-to-end design of Large Rotating Machines (motors, generators and synchronous condensers), Transformers, Power Drives, Switch Gear and Complex Systems for a variety of industry segments. With design authority (under corporate standards), you will be responsible for major and complex assignments with long-term business implications, manage complex issues within functional areas of expertise, and be instrumental to the overall business strategy.

Job Description

Role Summary/Purpose:

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) for the Power Conversion and Storage division in Latin America, the LATAM Director of Engineering will lead Engineering on Rotating machines (induction, DC, synchronous, PMM, synch reluctance, and other topologies) and Engineering of integrated electrical solutions (system design and integration, power electronics, automation, switchboards and installation) for products and projects within LATAM or exported from LATAM to many global regions, notably North America, Europe and the Middle East.

The role is both operational and strategic. It demands:

  • Transformational leadership skills – to guide the large organizational structure towards productivity, process standardization & maturity, speed and use of leading edge technology tools;

  • Technical depth – to foster an environment of creativity and innovative solutions, and to develop new business opportunities;

  • Seniority and executive presence – to interact with the customers in Latin America and abroad on complex engineering projects.

  • The role requires focus towards growth on the Latam region operation, and he/she will leverage the GE network, to drive product innovation, technology injections, structuring and cost-out through tools and processes in the areas of power electronics, automation, power systems, switchgears, rotor dynamics, vibration, electromagnetics, insulation, aero-thermo, structural, and both electrical and mechanical systems integration.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • The LATAM Director of Engineering directs a functional area of several engineering departments across the sites of Campinas, SP and Belo Horizonte, MG. Executes projects with great customer engagement and trust. Translates concepts, considers strategic options, develops tactics, and implements change. Creates programs in alignment with the external environment. Participates in cross-functional , multi-cultural teams.

  • Drives team performance to meet aggressive time and cost demands from our customers.

  • Develop, implement, and achieve performance KPIs.

  • Develop a roadmap for building world-class products and solutions, including electric machines, power electronics, switchgears, software and overall systems design capability.

  • Serves as technical expert in the technical community through demonstrated technical accomplishments which may include holding patents, component design and systems design experience, and strong knowledge of engineering design fundamentals.

  • Drives customer project execution and delivers on time and quality.

  • Leads and oversees quality engineering design, execution, and product safety; responsible for the oversight of the related sciences including materials and performance.

  • Provides guidance, leadership, mentoring and intervention, as necessary, to strengthen the discipline, quality, reliability and rigor of our engineering work.

  • Leads interactions with customers on technical issues.

  • Works with Power Conversion leadership to develop and build long term strategies.

  • Interacts with P&L engineering and technology leaders across GE to accelerate deployment of modern electrical and mechanical design tools and methodologies.

  • Works with P&L product leadership to reshape the overall Latam technical strategy and the organizational structure.

  • Provides leadership with high integrity and oversight of processes protecting intellectual property, export controlled and strategic technology.

Required Qualification:

  • Degree in Electric or Mechanical Engineering
  • Strong knowledge of Engineering Design Fundamentals and Engineering Processes
  • Extensive experience in mechanical and/or electrical systems design
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese mandatory
  • Industrial experience in relevant industry segments such as Oil and Gas, Power Generation, Mining & Steel and/or Marine will be a plus.
  • Subject Matter Expertise on Rotating Machines and/or Electrical Systems will be a plus.
Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

title: Senior Data Scientist - Computer Vision
description:
AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

The Senior Data Scientist will be responsible for developing and leading solutions at the intersection of Computer Vision, Computer Graphics, and Multimodal Models . This role involves tackling strategic challenges, combining traditional computer vision techniques with cutting‑edge scene reconstruction and generative AI, focusing on detection, classification, visual similarity, synthetic data generation, and multimodal interpretation. You will act as a technical reference within the team, guiding architectural decisions and defining the best approaches for complex visual problems. You will work in a highly collaborative, global environment, transforming visual data into robust and scalable models, ensuring automation, efficiency, and high performance across implemented pipelines. We are looking for someone with an analytical mindset, curiosity, a strong technical foundation in the mentioned areas, excellent communication skills, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for innovation and continuous learning.

What you'll do
  • Define and lead the technical approach for object detection solutions (e.g., YOLO, RT-DETR, and similar architectures), applying them to real‑world problems with an emphasis on performance, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Define and develop image classification strategies, with experience in architectures such as EfficientNet, MobileNet, and ResNet, focusing on production readiness.
  • Lead the development of Siamese networks for verification and visual similarity tasks, applying fine‑tuning and optimization strategies for image comparison and visual integrity validation.
  • Define and apply multimodal generative and instruction‑following models such as Qwen‑VL, PaliGemma, and BLIP, using fine‑tuning techniques like LoRA and QLoRA, focusing on image‑text alignment.
  • Knowledge of scene reconstruction techniques such as NeRF or Gaussian Splatting, and hands‑on experience with frameworks like Nerfstudio or similar.
  • Work with large volumes of visual data, coordinating curation, annotation, and qualitative evaluation strategies to ensure diversity and quality in image datasets.
  • Generate and use synthetic and 3D data as complementary sources for training and evaluating models, supporting their creation and curation to enhance model generalization and robustness.
  • Automate, version, and monitor training, inference, and deployment pipelines using Python, PySpark, MLflow, GitHub Actions, Docker, and CI/CD, running on cloud infrastructure (especially Azure and Databricks).
  • Mentor junior and mid‑level data scientists, supporting their technical growth and ensuring quality across the team's deliverables.
  • Communicate technical results and trade‑offs to senior stakeholders, ensuring strategic alignment of developed solutions.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, PMs, and business stakeholders, ensuring technical alignment and strategic impact of developed solutions.
  • Work in an agile, global environment, participating in Scrum/Kanban ceremonies, technical reviews, and continuous delivery and learning cycles.
What you'll need
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related fields. A master's or PhD is strongly preferred.
  • General and foundational knowledge in data science and statistics, including data analysis, modeling, and validation techniques.
  • Strong background in Deep Learning, including mastery of Transformer architectures and advanced algorithms applied to real‑world problems.
  • Proven experience building and deploying models for object detection, image classification, visual information extraction, and multimodal interpretation.
  • Proficiency in TensorFlow or PyTorch, with experience in model development and deployment.
  • Experience with cloud computing, particularly Azure, Databricks, and Spark, for large‑scale data processing.
  • Expertise in Python and PySpark, plus familiarity with data manipulation and modeling libraries and frameworks.
  • Knowledge of version control and collaboration tools such as GitHub, and experience with CI/CD pipelines for data and model projects.
  • Understanding of automation workflows, model monitoring, and best practices for maintaining performance and robustness.
  • Experience leading technical projects and guiding architectural decisions in data science or machine learning teams.
  • Experience deploying models to production environments, including optimization and monitoring.
  • Advanced English to operate in a global environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, communication, teamwork, organization, autonomy, and focus on delivering high‑quality results.

  • Conhecimento das Carnes: Tipos de Cortes: Saber identificar e realizar os diferentes cortes de carne (como filé, contrafilé, peito, etc.) e entender qual parte da carne é mais adequada para determinados pratos;
  • Qualidade da Carne: Conhecer os diferentes tipos de carne (bovina, suína, aves, etc.) e como avaliar sua qualidade.

  • Manipulação Segura: Manter as práticas de higiene rigorosas para evitar contaminação e garantir a segurança alimentar;
  • Armazenamento: Saber como armazenar corretamente a carne, incluindo temperatura adequada e condições de conservação;
  • Equipamentos: Uso de Ferramentas: Utilizar corretamente equipamentos como moedores de carne, serra de ossos, e cortadores;
  • Manutenção: Cuidar dos equipamentos e realizar a manutenção necessária para garantir que estejam sempre em boas condições;
  • Comunicação: Ser capaz de explicar aos clientes sobre os diferentes cortes e tipos de carne, oferecendo recomendações baseadas em suas preferências;

POR DENTRO DO ROLDÃO ATACADISTA

O Roldão Atacadista não é apenas uma empresa – é uma história de crescimento e transformação que vem sendo escrita há 24 anos. Tudo começou com a ideia de ser mais do que um atacadista. Nosso objetivo sempre foi ser um parceiro estratégico, abastecendo micros, pequenas e grandes empresas e levando soluções também para as casas dos nossos consumidores finais.

Essa trajetória só foi possível porque acreditamos no poder da nossa gente. Somos 4.800 colaboradores que não apenas trabalham aqui – eles constroem o Roldão todos os dias. Por isso, investimos na capacitação de cada um deles, acreditando que um time forte e preparado é o segredo para enfrentar os desafios do mercado e criar inovações que nos destacam.

Hoje, com 39 lojas espalhadas pelo estado de São Paulo, vivemos um momento de intensa expansão. E, para crescer, não olhamos apenas para fora, mas também para dentro. Temos o programa Ascensão de Líderes, com o propósito de formar gestores que inspirem, motivem e transformem. Aqui, os líderes são agentes de mudança, e é com o nosso DNA Roldão – Aqui é o lugar que eles ajudam a nossa gente a alcançar os objetivos mais altos.

Essa história é feita por pessoas que acreditam que o trabalho em equipe é o que nos diferencia. Se você sonha em crescer junto, em deixar sua marca em uma empresa que valoriza o esforço e o talento, o Roldão é o lugar certo para você.

Junte-se a nós e seja parte de um time que não para de crescer.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

Entre as oportunidades disponíveis nas farmácias de Campinas e região, 217 são para atendentes, cargo que exige ensino médio completo e idade mínima de 18 anos. Outras 23 vagas são destinadas a farmacêuticos. Para essa função, é necessário ensino superior completo e CRF ativo.

Na próxima semana, às vésperas do Carnaval, a RD Saúde vai colocar o bloco na rua, em Campinas, com dois mutirões com 200 vagas para o centro de distribuição de Itupeva. Há oportunidades (veja requisitos abaixo) para auxiliares de reposição, conferentes, analistas, assistentes, operadores de empilhadeira, auxiliar de manutenção predial, eletricista de manutenção predial, supervisores, motoristas categoria D e ajudantes de motorista.

O primeiro processo seletivo será na segunda-feira (9), das 9h às 16h, na Raia da Avenida Barão de Itapura, 1.616. Já na quinta-feira (12), das 9h às 16h, o feirão será na Universidade Anhanguera - Ouro Verde (Rua Emília Stefanelli Ceregatti, 160).

Sobre a RD Saúde

A RD Saúde foi formada em 2011, a partir da fusão entre a Droga Raia e a Drogasil, que combinam trajetória de mais de um século no varejo farmacêutico. Hoje, o grupo está presente em todos os estados do país, com mais de 3.500 farmácias. Em 2024, ao adotar uma nova marca corporativa, a companhia reforçou a sua atuação como ecossistema de saúde voltado para prestação de serviços e cuidados com o bem-estar da população. title: Senior Staff / Principal Engineer - Digital Ecosystem
description:
Opportunity

We are hiring a Senior Staff or Principal Engineer to support driving the technical vision and execution for Nubank’s Digital Ecosystem division, with initial focus on NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance. This is a division-level leadership role: you will work with exceptional engineers (including staff engineers), lead cross-org architectural decisions, negotiate trade-offs with product/finance/legal, and enable scalable delivery of high-impact products (checkout & wallet, advertiser platform and benefits hub, and 1-click insurance products).

Vision and contribution

2026's Vision And (how This Role Contributes). In 2026 we will transform the Digital Ecosystem into a place where customers discover advantages, pay effortlessly and feel protected, and where merchants grow through data-driven integrated partnerships. Our priorities are: (1) elevating app quality, (2) deepening customer engagement with contextual and personalized experiences, (3) making Nubank the preferred payments partner and growth engine for merchants, and (4) ensuring scalable, compliant, and financially healthy foundations. This role will own the technical plan to deliver that vision across NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance.

  • NuPay scales to become the de facto checkout and wallet for Nubank customers (TPV ×2 by Dec/26; wallet >3M MAU).
  • Ads & Rewards delivers the Advantages Tab, a performant advertiser platform and Ads POC with merchants, and drives material ecosystem revenue.
  • Insurance launches and scales high-quality one-click complements (Mobile Insurance Relaunch, Pix Protegido evolution), while maintaining aggressive SLOs, strong observability, controlled TCO and an elevated engineering culture.
Core Responsibilities
  • Support defining the division’s technical end-state (2–3 years): architecture, shard/partition strategy, migration path (one‑stack) and explicit trade-offs (cost × latency × availability).
  • Co-own availability and performance: set SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident playbooks and an observability strategy that supports merchants with strict SLAs.
  • Support Ads & Rewards platform design: advertiser platform (audience & campaign management), decision/bidding service, real-time vs batch decisioning, measurement & attribution (ROAS/incrementality), and minimise impact on app UX.
  • Drive NuPay ↔ Ads integration for aspirational purchases: real-time underwriting, multi-source funding, take-rate modelling, card-on-file / wallet flows and onboarding for flagship merchants.
  • Enable Insurance delivery: technical enablement for one-click products, partner integration and governance (e.g., Chubb), migration to subscription/billing platform where applicable, and app quality improvements (TTFD, dashboards, NPS).
  • Support one-stack discovery and phased migration: balance platformization with pragmatic delivery and tech-debt management to avoid blocking growth.
  • Catalyse product quality culture: introduce and operationalize Product Quality Reviews, drive app excellence rituals, and ensure UX/technical quality are considered across the product lifecycle.
  • Mentor and grow engineering leaders and staff engineers; run RFCs, tech talks and post-mortems; design career paths and enable managers to deliver cross-BU initiatives.
  • Represent the division in cross-org negotiations and external partner discussions (merchants, partners, regulators), aligning stakeholders and escalating risks proactively.
  • Track and report technical impact against business metrics and engineering health indicators.
Key business & engineering metrics you will influence
  • NuPay: TPV growth (2× by Dec/26), wallet MAU (>3M), share-of-checkout (SoC), p99 latency and availability for merchant traffic.
  • Ads & Rewards: ad revenue targets (material ecosystem revenue), ROAS / iROAS / incrementality, CTR, Ads POC results (≥2 merchants), Advantages Tab / Shelves Platform launch.
  • Insurance: one-click complements GWP target (R$493M EOY), product NPS (>60 targets), churn reduction via billing/tolerance changes.
  • Engineering health: Engineering Stability Index (ESI), App Quality Score, incident frequency/severity, time to integrate new partners.
Challenges And Opportunities (what You’ll Own)
  • World-class app quality & Magic App MVP: raise engineering and product expectations, and deliver first-layer Magic App experiences (Advantages Tab, widgets, contextual flows such as AIPB).
  • Real-time decisioning and aspirational financing: enable low-latency ads decisioning and NuPay real-time underwriting for extended financing while preserving app performance.
  • One-click Insurance at scale: deliver MIR (no IMEI) and Pix Protegido evolution, dedicating energy to one-click complements and partnering with Chubb while retaining monitoring/control.
  • Capture offline transactions: accelerate NuPay NFC wallet adoption as an offensive play to reach ~3M MAU and increase offline SoC.
  • Platform & compliance foundations: complete SPB integration, advance One-Stack Project, meet Magic App and regulatory mandates, and ensure resilient, cost-efficient infra.
What You’ll Find In The Team
  • High-calibre engineers, including staff engineers and experienced engineering managers.
  • Complex, high-impact problems at scale: large merchant integrations, real-time decisioning, strict SLOs and multi-partner dependencies.
  • Autonomy to shape architecture, product quality rituals and the division roadmap, plus the responsibility to align delivery across product, infra, legal and commercial stakeholders.
What You’ll Navigate
  • Heavy cross-BU dependencies (Global Platforms, Nubank+, UV, Marketing) requiring strong stakeholder orchestration.
  • Regulatory changes (SPB/BCB) that may force re-architecture or open-scheme decisions.
  • Dependence on third-party vendors (wallet SDKs, insurance partners) and partner infra limitations.
  • Balancing rapid commercialization and monetization with fraud/credit loss control and sustainable unit economics.
  • Trade-offs between accelerating one-stack migration and accepting short-term technical debt to preserve delivery velocity.

title: Coordenador(a) de CAD e Auditoria
description:
Descrição da vaga

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

#vemserveracruz #vemparahospitalcare #vemserhospitalcare #vemproveracruz #jeitodeserveracruz

#vemserhospitalcare #vemparahospitalcare #vemserhc #jeitodeserhc #jeitodeserhospitalcare

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Delegar e coordenar o desenvolvimento das atividades da Auditoria Interna e CAD, visando garantir a eficácia do trabalho realizado
  • Colaborar com os responsáveis dos diversos setores de enfermagem na resolução de problemas técnicos e administrativos referentes aos prontuários médicos, contas hospitalares e processos de trabalho assistenciais.
  • Supervisionar a análise de contas hospitalares realizadas pelos membros da equipe e a resolução de não conformidades nos prontuários dos pacientes
  • Supervisionar o agendamento das auditorias externas no setor, de acordo com cronogramas preestabelecidos pelos convênios, bem como o atendimento aos auditores dos convênios
  • Supervisionar o agendamento das datas de fechamentos de altas administrativas, visando enviar parciais da conta aos convênios, periodicamente
  • Supervisionar e elaborar os recursos de glosa, com as respectivas justificativas solicitadas, de acordo com questionamentos dos convênios e com base nas tabelas e taxas negociadas.
  • Participar de reuniões junto aos convênios, visando negociar o pagamento de materiais padronizados e com uso protocolado pela instituição.
  • Identificar as não conformidades dos processos de trabalho dos setores assistenciais e administrativos
  • Acompanhar as legislações e atualizações referentes aos convênios e inerentes à área de atuação.
  • Elaborar relatórios diversos, de acordo com a necessidade, visando fornecer subsídios ao superior imediato, gerências executivas e diretoria.
  • Resolver problemas referentes a conflitos no atendimento em geral, fornecendo informações, orientando e direcionando os problemas aos setores competentes.
  • Garantir o dimensionamento de pessoal adequado nos setores sob sua responsabilidade, elaborando, coordenando e revisando as escalas de serviço, folgas e férias, visando assegurar o número adequado de colaboradores.
  • Supervisionar a equipe nas questões referentes ao arquivamento de prontuários, fornecimento de informações e cópias dos atendimentos prestados, visando garantir a segurança das informações.
  • Atuar junto a Comissão de Padronização de Artigos Médico Hospitalares (COPAMH), participando da análise para aquisição de novos produtos, solicitando orçamentos e analisando o custo-benefício, visando avaliar a viabilidade de aquisição e padronização dos mesmos.
  • Solicitar orientações do departamento jurídico do hospital nas situações de maior complexidade.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operationalmodels. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master's degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Engineer Manager
description:
ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti's broader mission. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
- Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
- Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
- Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
- Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
- Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
- Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team's scope.
- Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts. WHAT IT TAKES - Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
- Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).
- Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
- Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment. Be fully aligned to our core values: - Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.
- Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
- Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
- Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER - Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
- Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
- Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.
- Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
- Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
- An open organisation. Titles don't define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone's work is seen and valued. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Senior Devops Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) Pj
description: Qual será o seu papel? Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas. Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente. Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes. Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem. Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa. Esperamos que você tenha: Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio). Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk). Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD. Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch). Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts. Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial): Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure). Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker. Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura. Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure) Contratação: PJ.

Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados. Principais Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT, com otimização de macros e templates. Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL. Implementar e manter processos de ETL, garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados. Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados. Analisar e reestruturar processos de ETL, facilitando a migração para a nova arquitetura de dados. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções escaláveis. Requisitos e Qualificações: ✅ Experiência sólida com DBT, modelagem de dados e práticas de orquestração de pipelines. ✅ Conhecimento avançado em BigQuerye Looker e estruturação de dados no Google Cloud Platform (GCP). ✅ Proficiência em SQL para otimização e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados. ✅ Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de scripts de transformação e automação de dados. ✅ Conhecimento avançado em ETL (Informatica PowerCenter, Talend, DataStage, Hadoop e entre outras). ✅ Experiência prévia em projetos de migração de dados e integração entre diferentes plataformas. ✅ Diferencial: Vivência no setor financeiro e familiaridade com práticas de governança de dados. Auxílio com certificações oficiais, com 100% de reembolso ou vouchers. Parcerias com instituições de ensino para graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas. Contratação PJ. Trabalho 100% remoto, atuando em cliente do segmento financeiro. Sobre a ATRA: A ATRA é referência em tecnologia e inovação, atuando há mais de 15 anos no mercado de engenharia de dados, data analytics, governança e privacidade. Somos parceiros de grandes empresas como Microsoft, Google, Informatica, Denodo, Atlan e BigID, desenvolvendo soluções que transformam dados em ativos estratégicos. Com um ambiente colaborativo e inovador, buscamos profissionais apaixonados por tecnologia e transformação digital. Se interessou pela vaga? Inscreva-se e venha fazer parte do nosso time.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines,regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimentoprático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimentoem Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters: You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have... 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description: At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. About The Opportunity We are looking for a Product Designer to join a fast-paced, product-driven environment focused on building innovative digital experiences in the data and financial technology space. Responsibilities Own the end-to-end design process, from discovery and research to delivery and developer handoff. Conduct user research, usability testing, and validation to inform design decisions. Translate complex concepts into clear, intuitive, and accessible user experiences. Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to align vision and execution. Ensure consistency, usability, and high-quality visual design across all touchpoints. Support the creation of marketing and web assets aligned with brand guidelines. Required Qualifications Strong experience in Product Design with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product work. Proficiency in Figma for design, prototyping, and developer handoff. Ability to simplify complex systems and concepts into intuitive user experiences. Hands-on experience with user research, discovery, and validation methods. Experience building and evolving Design Systems in collaboration with engineering teams. Ability to work independently in high-ambiguity, fast-paced environments. Strong collaboration skills and a user-centered mindset. Experience using tools such as user journey mapping, flow diagrams, and prototyping techniques. Understanding of different levels of design fidelity, from low-fidelity concepts to production-ready designs. Advanced to Fluent level of English (mandatory). Nice To Have Skills Experience with Webflow or Framer for marketing or institutional websites. Background in AI, privacy, or data-related products. Experience designing native mobile applications (iOS and Android). Experience working on products in early-stage or product-market fit environments. Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code's consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You'll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Llm Scientist
description: We are looking for an\ "LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing. Key Responsibilities Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters. Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy. Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency. Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers. Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets. Qualification Required Extensive experience with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate). Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures. Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models. Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS SageMaker/GCP Vertex Al). Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions. Nice to Have Advanced Degree: A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP. Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration. Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization). Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public GitHub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the GenAl space. Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization. About Our Client Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process. The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

Strong background managing projects within Oracle ecosystems (Oracle EBS ERP and related solutions) and legacy systems. title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.G., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving;
ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;
capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.
